caption: This drawing depicts a steam-powered fire engine being pulled by two horses. The fire engine is primarily silver in color with various metallic details and is equipped with a large cylindrical boiler, a rounded steam whistle, and several pipes and valves. The fire engine is mounted on three large spoked wheels, all of which are painted red with some black details. The center and rear wheels are significantly larger than the front one. The two horses, colored dark brown with black harnesses, are shown in motion, attached to the engine with leather straps connected to the shafts of the vehicle. The horses are positioned side by side, and both have their legs extended in a running stance, facing to the right. The background is plain and uncolored, leaving the focus solely on the detailed rendering of the fire engine and the horses.
title: Toy Fire Engine
